findings.title: `upsampled_count()` is emitted by the transform but registered only in the discover dataset config
findings.description: `transform_query_columns_for_error_upsampling` rewrites `count()` to `"upsampled_count() as count"`. The new `upsampled_count` SnQL function is added only in `src/sentry/search/events/datasets/discover.py`. `_should_apply_sample_weight_transform` returns True for the `errors` dataset, so the rewritten string can reach a dataset config that does not define `upsampled_count`. I could not check the errors dataset config from the diff alone. If it does not register the function, error-dataset queries that match the allowlist will fail to resolve the column.

findings.title: `topEvents` error message changed in an unrelated hunk
findings.description: The validation message changed from `"If topEvents needs to be at least 1"` to `"topEvents needs to be at least 1"`. The change is unrelated to error upsampling. Any existing test or client that asserts the old string will break. I could not check existing test assertions from the diff.

findings.title: Cache key is shared across tests that mock the allowlist differently
findings.description: `is_errors_query_for_error_upsampled_projects` caches the eligibility result for 60 seconds under `error_upsampling_eligible:{org_id}:{hash(project_ids)}`. The new endpoint tests mock `options` differently per test but reuse the same project IDs. If the cache is not cleared between tests, a cached `True` from the allowlisted test can carry into the partial and no-allowlist tests and change their results. I could not confirm the cache backend or teardown from the diff.

`topEvents` error message changed in an unrelated hunk
